name: Creamy Garlic Parmesan Pasta
ingredients: Pasta, Butter, Garlic, Heavy Cream, Parmesan Cheese, Salt, Black Pepper, Parsley
instructions: Boil the pasta in salted water | Melt butter in a pan over medium heat. | Add minced garlic and sauté until fragrant. | Pour in the heavy cream and stir. | Add parmesan cheese, salt and black pepper. | Add the cooked pasta and mix until coated. | Garnish with chopped parsley and serve.

name: Fluffy Banana Pancakes
ingredients: Banana, Flour, Egg, Milk, Baking Powder, Sugar, Vanilla Extract, Butter
instructions: Mash the banana in a mixing bowl. | Add the egg, milk, sugar, and vanilla extract. | Add flour and baking powder. | Stir until a smooth batter forms. | Melt butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat. | Pour some batter into the pan. | Flip when bubbles appear and cook until golden brown. | Serve warm with your favorite toppings.

name: Chicken Fried Rice
ingredients: Chicken, Cooked Rice, Egg, Carrot, Peas, Soy Sauce, Garlic, Vegetable Oil, Green Onion
instructions: Cut the chicken into small pieces. | Heat vegetable oil in a large pan. | Add garlic and cook until fragrant. | Add chicken and cook until fully cooked. | Add chopped carrots and peas. | Push everything to one side and scramble the egg. | Add cooked rice and soy sauce. | Mix everything together. | Garnish with chopped green onions and serve.

name: Chocolate Mug Cake
ingredients: Flour, Cocoa Powder, Sugar, Milk, Vegetable Oil, Baking Powder, Vanilla Extract, Chocolate Chips
instructions: Add flour, cocoa powder, sugar, and baking powder to a microwave-safe mug. | Mix the dry ingredients together. | Add milk, vegetable oil, and vanilla extract. | Stir until the batter is smooth. | Add chocolate chips. | Microwave for approximately 60–90 seconds. | Allow it to cool slightly before serving.

name: Creamy Mushroom Chicken
ingredients: Chicken Breast, Mushrooms, Heavy Cream, Garlic, Butter, Olive Oil, Onion, Chicken Broth, Salt, Black Pepper, Thyme
instructions: Season chicken breasts with salt and black pepper. | Heat olive oil and butter in a skillet. | Cook chicken until golden and fully cooked. | Remove chicken from the skillet and set aside | Add chopped onion and garlic to the same skillet. | Add sliced mushrooms and cook until softened. | Pour in chicken broth and heavy cream. | Add thyme and stir the sauce. | Return the chicken to the skillet. | Simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens. | Serve warm.

name: Shakshuka (شكشوكة)
ingredients: 2 eggs, 2 tomatoes, ½ onion, 1 tablespoon olive oil, salt, black pepper, cumin.
instructions:
Chop the onion and tomatoes.
Cook the onion in olive oil.
Add tomatoes and spices.
Crack the eggs into the sauce.
Cover until the eggs are cooked.
